lessons_learned: Lesson learned: gdocs mutate sed calculates range offsets on paragraphs containing multi-byte UTF-8 punctuation or Zotero spans with off-by-N drift across paragraph breaks, and sed |T.R.C| can apply global table replacements across matching single-glyph cells. Prevention runbook checklist: use gdocs update-table (with non-empty cells) for tables, gdocs mutate replace for short single tokens, and gdocs readonly structure --json + descending delete-range/insert in gdocs mutate batch for paragraph rewrites.
